newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end firmer,boosted by rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end firmer,boosted by rate cut.

text.p: An interest rate cut and a slightly stronger peso drove Philippine shares higher on Friday but profit-taking in midsession pared some of the gains, traders said.
The main index finished 52.57 points up, or 2.01 percent, at 2,672.95 points. The market key barometer closed off its intra-day high of 2,697.07 points.
